jyutping: ok3 han2 han2 ge3 ngaan5 san4

english.note: Use this for someone’s angry or fierce look at another person.

examples.english: When they heard I was quitting, they gave me a glare.
examples.traditional: 佢一聽到我辭職，就用惡狠狠嘅眼神望住我。
